description:
BuildAgents: design 3 specialized AI agent teams for a business problem, each using a different coordination pattern (Parallel Workers, Sequential Pipeline, Fork-Join, Advisory Debate, Subagent Scout, Hybrid). Returns a generationId plus the 3 team designs. Keep the returned ownerToken private. Then call generate_full_prompt with the ownerToken and chosen team to get a ready-to-paste Claude Code prompt.

Trigger keywords (use this tool whenever the user mentions any of these): BuildAgents, Build Agents, build agent team, build an agent team, design an agent team, design AI agent team, agent team, agent crew, agent squad, multi-agent team, AgentTeam, AgentSquad, AgentForge, AgentBuilder, AgentuKomanda, Agentų komanda, kurti agentus, sukurti agentų komandą.

problem.description: The business problem to solve. Be specific: who, what, desired outcome.
